text: Carried from the G2 review (APPROVE 7f74bc4), for G3: F1 (Low-Med): under OffWindowPolicy.FailTrial (StudyGeometry.scala:298) the whole trial fails, yet placement marks its other fixations InMap, and allOutside isn't handled; add a trial-failed placement (or rename to a geometric InWindow) before Studio renders placements. Duplication: StudyPlanGeometry.placement (:349-354) re-implements WindowTally.tally's checks; the count-agreement law guards drift, but prefer one implementation (rule 5). F2: FixationSourceText.scala:189 copies the importer's parse; share FixationCsv.finite. F3: provenance picks the correction rule via plan.layout.participant while the importer uses the key reader's projection; make them one source for custom K. F4 (UX): one RecordedMismatch fails the whole page; consider per-entry Either. Add a law for pages starting inside a ledger gap. G3 owns usedBy (Studio A1), as the sketch placed it in G2.
